headlines.title: Is the AI Storage Boom Over? Why SanDisk’s Oct. 29 Earnings Could Prove the Doubters Wrong
headlines.summary: SanDisk shares shed nearly a third of their value in a month as Wall Street declared the AI storage cycle dead, but Thursday's earnings report carries enough firepower to make those doubters look very wrong.

headlines.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Flags Industry Supply Chain Constraints As Memory Production Timelines Tighten
headlines.summary: Sandisk (NasdaqGS:SNDK) is among memory suppliers referenced as affected by supply chain constraints highlighted by Lam Research. Lam Research flagged ongoing semiconductor equipment and component bottlenecks, signaling pressure on production timelines for memory and storage manufacturers. These supply challenges could influence how Sandisk plans and communicates around manufacturing capacity and delivery schedules.

headlines.title: Sandisk's New Business Model Is Transforming the Business. Now Is the Time to Buy the Stock.
headlines.summary: Sandisk is entering into contractual agreements rather than just selling on the open market.

headlines.title: Micron and Sandisk Hit Record Memory Margins. There's One Clear Winner.
headlines.summary: Sandisk and Micron are shifting their business models.

description: Sandisk Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally. The company provides solid state drives for desktop and notebook PCs, gaming consoles, and set top boxes; and flash-based embedded storage products for mobile phones, tablets, notebook PCs and other portable and wearable devices, automotive applications, Internet of Things, industrial, and connected home applications, as well as removable cards, universal serial bus drives, and wafers and components. It sells its products to computer manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers, datacenters, private cloud customers, cloud service providers, resellers, distributors, and retailers through its sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. Sandisk Corporation was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Milpitas, California.
